content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

When it comes to selling digital products, options like Gumroad and Payhip seem appealing but come with crippling fees. Gumroad charges 10% per sale, which quickly adds up, especially for creators selling high-value products. In contrast, NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee on transactions, allowing creators to retain a larger portion of their earnings. This significant difference in fee structures means that creators can take home more revenue by choosing a crypto-based solution. Additionally, platforms that rely on traditional payment processors often impose restrictions that hinder creators in certain regions, making them less effective for a global audience.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Gumroad and PayPal frequently block users from countries facing economic sanctions or unstable currencies. As a result, many digital creators in regions like Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and Ethiopia find themselves unable to access these services. On the other hand, a sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH is built to empower these creators directly. With tools that allow for the deployment of a fully functional online store using cryptocurrency, creators can operate independently of the restrictions imposed by conventional payment platforms. This sovereignty ensures that creators can build their businesses without being hampered by geographical or economic limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Speed and cost are critical factors when choosing a payment processor. Gumroad's 10% cut significantly diminishes profit margins, especially with high sales volumes. For example, if a creator sells 100 products at $97 each, the fee difference would result in a staggering $921 retained by the creator when using NOWPayments instead. This not only enhances profitability but also allows for quicker reinvestment into the creator's business. Moreover, cryptocurrencies confirm transactions almost instantly, whereas traditional payment methods can take days to process. This combination of low fees and fast payment processing makes crypto an attractive option for digital creators.
Gumroad's 10% fee can destroy your profits.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the standout features of using a sovereign commerce stack is the complete ownership of the infrastructure. Unlike platforms that retain control over your data and revenue, with COREMERCH, creators own everything after deployment. This ensures that their hard work is not only protected but also scalable. Automation is also a key benefit, with Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script enabling seamless delivery of digital products instantly upon purchase. This level of automation reduces operational overhead and enhances the customer experience, making it easier for creators to focus on what they do best—creating.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you're starting small and need a quick setup, the Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal. For those looking for a more robust solution with added features like email configuration and multiple product listings, the Edge Commerce Stack offers a comprehensive package. The Complete Builder Kit, which includes all blueprints and templates, provides an all-in-one solution for creators aiming to build, deploy, and scale their digital commerce operations efficiently. Assess your needs carefully to choose the stack that empowers your creative business.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign commerce setup that leverages cryptocurrency. Platforms like COREMERCH enable you to create a fully operational online store with instant payment processing and automated delivery. This architecture bypasses traditional payment restrictions, allowing you to effectively monetize your work.
NOWPayments allows you to retain 99.5% of every sale.

You can find it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Empower your selling strategy with a system built for creators.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
